summary: DJR's page for Job Clarendon, a condensed Clarendon homage to letterpress job printing. The page is mostly a gallery of twenty-six commissioned job-printing posters (images in a 1-, 2- and 3-up grid), broken by electric-blue and mint-green 'breakout' panels that explain widths, weights, the tailed R, squared terminals and the stylistic sets. A sticky Try/Typeset/PDF/Buy bar follows the whole scroll; the DJR cart closes the page.
